POLICY  (as resolved)
  codec: opus  (coupled 128000 bps, uncoupled 64000 bps)
  loudness: measure -- embedded loudness values are measured at
    execution on rendered layouts (BS.1770), never typed
  profile: auto -- derived per target from element/channel arithmetic
  validate: fail_on_error -- every output passes through the Sentinel gate at
    run time (L3 rendered QC when oracles are present); findings S-320/S-321
    escalate to run-failing on Loom-packaged outputs

TARGET 1/1: review/dub_de.binaural.wav
  format: preview   profile: base   backend: iamftools
  why this route:
    preview: stereo binaural review render (R9). iamf-tools primary encode
    (ADR-1) to an intermediate .iamf that is never a deliverable, rendered by
    decoder_main --output_layout=Binaural (the obr renderer, invoked
    subprocess-only — ADR-4). Single-oracle render: iamfdec's binauralizer is
    disabled toolchain-wide (F10), so verification is structural + spectral,
    never cross-decoder.
  steps (execution order):
     1. s00-stage-0-main  [stage_input, internal]
        from $SRCDIR/wavs/main.wav; to $WORK/wav/main.wav
        why: single input_wav_directory for encoder_main; staged copy pins the
          bytes the plan's source hash refers to
     2. s00-stage-1-vo_en  [stage_input, internal]
        from $SRCDIR/wavs/vo_en.wav; to $WORK/wav/vo_en.wav
        why: single input_wav_directory for encoder_main; staged copy pins the
          bytes the plan's source hash refers to
     3. s00-stage-2-vo_de  [stage_input, internal]
        from $SRCDIR/wavs/vo_de.wav; to $WORK/wav/vo_de.wav
        why: single input_wav_directory for encoder_main; staged copy pins the
          bytes the plan's source hash refers to
     4. t00-dub_de_binaural-cfg  [write_config, internal]
        to $WORK/cfg/t00-dub_de_binaural.textproto
        why: original textproto emitter (D-L6); loudness fields absent —
          encoder_main measures natively (G2b)
     5. t00-dub_de_binaural-enc  [encode, encoder_main]
        writes $WORK/prev/t00-dub_de_binaural/enc/t00-dub_de_binaural.iamf
        why: preview: stereo binaural review render (R9). iamf-tools primary
          encode (ADR-1) to an intermediate .iamf that is never a deliverable,
          rendered by decoder_main --output_layout=Binaural (the obr renderer,
          invoked subprocess-only — ADR-4). Single-oracle render: iamfdec's
          binauralizer is disabled toolchain-wide (F10), so verification is
          structural + spectral, never cross-decoder.
     6. t00-dub_de_binaural-render-binaural  [render, decoder_main]
        writes $WORK/prev/t00-dub_de_binaural/binaural.wav
        why: R9: binaural stereo render of the gate-validated intermediate via
          decoder_main --output_layout=Binaural (obr, subprocess — ADR-4);
          single-oracle: iamfdec's binauralizer is disabled toolchain-wide
          (F10); R8: renders presentation 'dub-de-de' (mix_presentation_id 43
          pinned — D-Z6; the selection, defaulting to the first presentation,
          is a render choice, never metadata)
     7. t00-dub_de_binaural-measure-binaural  [measure_bs1770, sentinel-dsp]
        why: R9: review-copy loudness (sentinel-dsp kernel — conformant
          engine, F34), recorded in the ledger only — wav/ogg carry no IAMF
          loudness structures, so nothing is embedded (noted, not glossed)
     8. t00-dub_de_binaural-verify  [verify_preview, ffmpeg]
        why: R9 accept: 2 ch at the source rate, frame count exact vs the
          source program, measured IL above the -70 LUFS gating floor
          (digital-silence guard); per-channel peaks recorded, not run-failing
          (a quiet channel is a program fact)
     9. t00-dub_de_binaural-out  [copy, internal]
        from $WORK/prev/t00-dub_de_binaural/binaural.wav; to
          $OUTDIR/review/dub_de.binaural.wav
        why: deliver the verified binaural render to the target path (delivery
          is the last step — a failed verify ships nothing)

NOTES
  $TOOLCHAIN / $WORK / $OUTDIR / $SRCDIR are execution-time roots; plans are
    environment-portable and contain no absolute paths.
